rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a system that requires payment or a subscription to access content.

example.english: This website has a paywall, and you can't read the full article without subscribing.
example.traditional: 呢個網站有付費牆，唔訂閱就睇唔到全文。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 mong5 zaam6 jau5 fu6 fai3 coeng4 m4 ding3 jyut6 zau6 tai2 m4 dou3 cyun4 man4
